name: odoo-harness
description: Claude Code harness for Odoo projects: one plugin for Odoo 17.0 to 20.0, installed once per machine.

plugins.name: odoo-harness
plugins.description: Harness for Odoo 17.0 to 20.0 projects, installed once per machine: the odoo-harness command (state files, WIP=1 features, 3-layer verification with pylint-odoo, Odoo tests and Playwright), automatic session hooks, an Odoo skill per version.
